narration: So flight isn't magic. It's just wings endlessly throwing sky downward to hold themselves up.
description: React Three Fiber wide shot, same jet model now level cruising left-to-right at 45% vertical in dark blue-black sky. Two soft volumetric trails in accent=cyan and muted=grey curl downward below wings and trail behind, curving down to show downwash. fg=white jet with accent2=magenta rim. Gentle god-ray. Camera follows alongside with slow pull-back revealing longer trails, slight orbit for 3D depth. Nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: wide jet cruises level center-frame leaving faint level contrails
trails brighten cyan and start curling downward below wings
camera pushes to wings as downwash tubes thicken and glow
animated cyan particles fire continuously downward from wings
trails curl strongly down and back, jet rides steadily on reaction
soft yellow up-glow pulses under wings as jet holds altitude cruising forward
